project.name: grounded-docparse
project.description: Workstation-oriented grounded document parser that produces structured Markdown and JSON from PDFs and images while preserving local OCR evidence.

nodes.name: Grounded Document Processing
nodes.summary: Transforms source PDFs and images into normalized page evidence, local OCR regions, analyzed drafts, and grounded rendered outputs. The domain keeps layout and geometry evidence available through downstream processing.

businessRules: Local OCR layout and geometry evidence remain the basis for downstream results.
Optional AI recovery does not replace grounded evidence.
crossDomainInteractions: Supplies grounded outputs to extraction and conversational features.
Provides results evaluated by quality and benchmark workflows.

nodes.name: Agentic Extraction And Review
nodes.summary: Builds user-facing extraction, classification, routing, and chat workflows on top of grounded parser outputs. It uses schemas and page evidence to produce reviewable structured results rather than bypassing the parser model.

businessRules: Agentic workflows operate on grounded parser outputs.
Structured extraction follows supplied schemas and document evidence.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes grounded results from document processing.
Uses workspace persistence and runtime provider services.

nodes.name: Quality And Evaluation
nodes.summary: Assesses document quality, confidence, recovery candidates, corpus metrics, and regression-policy outcomes. It gives operators evidence for quality decisions and repeatable benchmark reporting.

businessRules: Recovery candidates are selected from evidence-based quality analysis.
Evaluation policies define minimum quality and allowed regressions.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides reports and policies for operational decisions.

nodes.name: Runtime And Workspace Operations
nodes.summary: Configures providers and OCR services, manages the local WSL runtime, and persists schemas and workspace state. It supports both interactive Streamlit use and batch or CLI automation.

businessRules: Runtime settings centralize provider, OCR, quality, and recovery configuration.
The local OCR stack is managed as an exclusive service runtime.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides infrastructure and persistence to document-processing and extraction workflows.

nodes.name: Ingest And Normalize Document
nodes.summary: Converts uploaded PDFs or images into normalized page evidence suitable for the parser pipeline.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Streamlit document upload or parser API

nodes.name: Analyze And Render Grounded Result
nodes.summary: Coordinates OCR, page analysis, quality-aware recovery, and rendering into the final grounded parse result.

nodes.name: Extract Structured Fields
nodes.summary: Applies an extraction schema to grounded document results and produces structured fields for review.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Streamlit Extract workflow or public Python API

nodes.name: Route Mixed Form Packets
nodes.summary: Classifies and segments mixed documents before extracting only eligible forms with the appropriate routing profile.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Streamlit routing workflow or public Python API

nodes.name: Assess Parser Quality
nodes.summary: Identifies incomplete or risky content and determines evidence-based repair candidates during parsing.

nodes.name: Evaluate Corpus Regression
nodes.summary: Runs corpus evaluation, aggregates metrics, applies regression policy, and writes evaluation artifacts.

nodes.name: Provision Local OCR Runtime
nodes.summary: Installs and launches the WSL-based local OCR stack, selecting suitable runtime support for available hardware.

nodes.name: Manage Workspace State
nodes.summary: Persists reusable schemas and workspace state so users can resume and manage document workflows.

nodes.name: Render Source Pages
nodes.summary: Normalizes PDF and image sources into page-level evidence.

nodes.name: Run Local OCR
nodes.summary: Creates consistent local OCR regions through supported OCR runtimes.

nodes.name: Assemble Page Evidence
nodes.summary: Packages normalized page representation for later analysis.

nodes.name: Analyze Layout And Reading Order
nodes.summary: Combines OCR, layout features, reading order, and visual evidence into page drafts.

nodes.name: Apply Targeted Recovery
nodes.summary: Uses quality analysis to select evidence-based repair candidates.

nodes.name: Render Output Artifacts
nodes.summary: Materializes grounded Markdown, structured elements, and annotated PDFs.

nodes.name: Define Extraction Schema
nodes.summary: Creates or loads a schema that specifies the requested document fields.

nodes.name: Compile Grounded Context
nodes.summary: Builds evidence-backed context from parser outputs for extraction.

nodes.name: Validate Structured Result
nodes.summary: Produces structured extraction output against the requested schema.

nodes.name: Classify Document Segments
nodes.summary: Classifies document content for routing decisions.

nodes.name: Select Routing Profile
nodes.summary: Associates eligible segments with the appropriate form-routing profile.

nodes.name: Extract Eligible Forms
nodes.summary: Extracts only forms that meet the selected profile requirements.

nodes.name: Detect Risky Content
nodes.summary: Identifies incomplete or risky page content and confidence issues.

nodes.name: Compare OCR Evidence
nodes.summary: Assesses disagreement across OCR evidence to surface uncertain content.

nodes.name: Select Repair Candidates
nodes.summary: Chooses targeted recovery candidates based on available evidence.

nodes.name: Load Corpus Manifest
nodes.summary: Loads the corpus definition, source documents, annotations, and evaluation coverage.

nodes.name: Compute Quality Metrics
nodes.summary: Calculates corpus and document metrics from parser results.

nodes.name: Apply Regression Policy
nodes.summary: Checks measured results against minimums and allowed regressions.

nodes.name: Write Evaluation Report
nodes.summary: Writes live evaluation artifacts and report output.

nodes.name: Check Platform And Hardware
nodes.summary: Verifies Windows, WSL, hardware, and prerequisite availability.

nodes.name: Install Runtime Dependencies
nodes.summary: Installs the selected WSL OCR runtime and required services.

nodes.name: Launch Service Stack
nodes.summary: Starts the local OCR and Streamlit service stack.

nodes.name: Store Reusable Schemas
nodes.summary: Persists reusable extraction schemas for later workflows.

nodes.name: Save Workflow State
nodes.summary: Persists document and workflow state across workspace sessions.

nodes.name: Restore Interrupted Work
nodes.summary: Reopens persisted work while isolating invalid or interrupted results.

edges.description: Grounded parse results and evidence are the inputs for extraction, routing, and chat workflows.
Quality analysis and corpus evaluation assess parser evidence and results.
Runtime configuration and local OCR services support document processing.
Workspace persistence and provider runtime support reusable extraction workflows.
